sql_query:
WITH first_sellers AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    MIN(order_item_id) AS min_item
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
order_seller AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id AS ord_id,
    oi.seller_id
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN first_sellers fs
    ON oi.order_id = fs.order_id
   AND oi.order_item_id = fs.min_item
),
order_coords AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id AS ord_id,
    gc.geolocation_lat  AS cust_lat,
    gc.geolocation_lng  AS cust_lng,
    gs.geolocation_lat  AS sell_lat,
    gs.geolocation_lng  AS sell_lng
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN geolocation gc
    ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = gc.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  JOIN order_seller os
    ON o.order_id = os.ord_id
  JOIN sellers s
    ON os.seller_id = s.seller_id
  JOIN geolocation gs
    ON s.seller_zip_code_prefix = gs.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*)                                      AS delivered_count,
  AVG(dist_km)                                  AS avg_distance,
  approx_quantile(dist_km, 0.5)                 AS median_distance,
  approx_quantile(dist_km, 0.95)                AS p95_distance,
  stddev(dist_km)                               AS stddev_distance,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dist_km <= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)            AS cnt_0_10,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dist_km > 10 AND dist_km <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS cnt_10_50,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dist_km > 50 AND dist_km <= 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_50_200,
  SUM(CASE WHEN dist_km > 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)               AS cnt_gt_200
FROM (
  SELECT
    ord_id,
    6371.0 * acos(
      LEAST(
        1.0,
        GREATEST(
          -1.0,
          cos(radians(cust_lat)) * cos(radians(sell_lat)) * cos(radians(sell_lng) - radians(cust_lng))
          + sin(radians(cust_lat)) * sin(radians(sell_lat))
        )
      )
    ) AS dist_km
  FROM order_coords
) distances;
